command_block:
export PATH=/opt/data/bin:/opt/data/opt/go/bin:$PATH
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path("internal/addrs/checkable.go")
s = p.read_text()
old = 'name, nameDiags := getCheckableName("input", "variable value")'
new = 'name, nameDiags := getCheckableName("var", "variable value")'
assert s.count(old) == 1
p.write_text(s.replace(old, new))
PY
gofmt -w internal/addrs/checkable.go
go test ./internal/addrs -run '^TestBaselineV3ParseInputVariableCheckable$'
